name: Bounce Kiyovu
geoNote: 16 KN 47 Street pin (Baso café adjacent — same civic address as club listings)
description: Bounce Kiyovu is a Kigali padel and tennis address on KN 47 Street in Kiyovu, with published phone and app booking. A clear recommendation when you want a named Rwanda padel stop in the city centre rather than an informal court. Confirm padel court availability and open play before you go — coaching and junior clinics are also listed.
sourceTypes: Bounce club page; Padel Lands Rwanda
researchNotes: Other Kigali venues (e.g. Mamba) noted in travel blogs but not double-sourced within this audit pass
